title: The change count in the grid's edit bar
stem: After a column's rule type is changed on a 3-range matrix (and nothing else), how many changes should the edit bar count?

options.t: 1: the column whose rule type differs counts as one change
3: one per changed box, as the design draws

context: The PRD counts "each column whose rule type differs" as one change, but also counts each changed box. The design shows "3 changes" for one type change on a 3-range column.
where: PRD Story 4 (the edit bar); Tiered Pricing design canvas, picture 4.11
